brief.intent: Two shots: an empty railway station, then a train departing. A continuous off-screen voice says exactly the supplied line across both shots, starting in shot one and finishing in shot two. Show only the supplied sign text in shot one. No other dialogue or music.

request.instruction: Two shots: an empty railway station, then a train departing. A continuous off-screen voice says exactly the supplied line across both shots, starting in shot one and finishing in shot two. Show only the supplied sign text in shot one. No other dialogue or music.

constraints.text: The target contains no music, including copied background music.

subjects: An empty railway station platform with tiled flooring, pillars and tracks along the platform edge
A hanging overhead sign displaying the lettering 出口 EXIT 07
shots.action: A wide, static view holds on an empty railway station platform: bare tiled ground, a row of platform pillars, tracks receding past the platform edge, and a hanging sign overhead that reads 出口 EXIT 07. No travellers are present and nothing in the frame moves; the off-screen narrator's voice begins speaking the line over this still, unpopulated platform.
shots.what_changes: The empty station platform and its sign are established, and the off-screen spoken line starts.

subjects: A commuter train pulling away from the platform and receding along the tracks
The empty railway station platform left behind, with pillars and the platform edge
shots.action: The shot cuts to the same platform view as a commuter train pulls away along the tracks, its carriages sliding past and receding into the distance beyond the platform end, leaving the platform empty behind it. The off-screen narrator's voice finishes the line over the departing train, and no further text appears anywhere in the frame.
shots.what_changes: The train departs and recedes down the track, and the off-screen spoken line concludes.
